summary:
An Israeli strike hit Nasser hospital in southern Gaza, killing six people including a surgeon and wounding 28, according to the hospital director. Witnesses said a missile struck a building containing the surgical wards and intensive care units. The hospital is one of the few remaining medical facilities in the strip. Israel said Hamas was using the hospital as a military command center.

Unions said 4 million workers, about one-fifth of the workforce, joined Spain's first general strike in 14 years, called over housing and the high cost of living. Other accounts put participation at tens of thousands. The strike was mostly peaceful, but clashes erupted in parts of Barcelona and Madrid in the evening.

US envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff met Vladimir Putin in Moscow after two days of trilateral talks in the UAE that yielded no breakthrough. Ukraine said its military Starlink service was disrupted again, hurting drones that lose connectivity above 100 miles an hour. The envoys are due in Dublin on Thursday to meet Volodymyr Zelensky, who said Europe should become a regular part of negotiations with Russia.

headlines.title: Israeli strike hits Gaza's Nasser hospital, killing six
headlines.summary: An Israeli strike hit Nasser hospital in southern Gaza, killing six people including a surgeon, according to the hospital director. Israel said Hamas was using the hospital as a military command center.

headlines.title: Millions join Spain's first general strike in 14 years
headlines.summary: Unions said 4 million workers joined Spain's first general strike in 14 years over housing and living costs. Clashes broke out in Barcelona and Madrid in the evening, after a mostly peaceful day.

headlines.title: US envoys meet Putin in Moscow after Abu Dhabi talks
headlines.summary: Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff met Vladimir Putin in Moscow after two days of trilateral talks in the UAE produced no breakthrough. They are due in Dublin on Thursday to meet Volodymyr Zelensky.

headlines.title: Nvidia board weighs CEO Jensen Huang's future amid affair reports
headlines.summary: Nvidia's board reportedly met to decide whether to oust CEO Jensen Huang after reports of an affair with a woman US intelligence believes to be a Chinese spy. China on Thursday accused the US of fabricating spy claims to justify a technology blockade.

headlines.title: Indonesian vice president Gibran resigns amid eligibility dispute
headlines.summary: Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka resigned amid a dispute over his eligibility, as a court questioned his overseas education. The news comes as President Prabowo Subianto faces a growing rift with his predecessor Joko Widodo, Gibran's father.

headlines.title: Democrat Scott Colom wins Mississippi Senate seat
headlines.summary: Democrat Scott Colom defeated Republican Cindy Hyde-Smith after more than a week of counting ballots. He is the state's first Black senator since 1875, or in 145 years by another count.

headlines.title: Kenya begins 42-day countdown after last Ebola patient discharged
headlines.summary: Kenya discharged its last Ebola patient and released 11 others who had been in quarantine on Wednesday, November 11. The country began a 42-day countdown to being declared Ebola-free after nine confirmed cases.

headlines.title: Brooklyn building collapse kills two, injures at least 17
headlines.summary: A three-story building in Brooklyn's Flatbush area collapsed on Wednesday afternoon into a neighboring construction site. Authorities said two people were killed and at least 17 injured, including children, as firefighters searched for trapped people.
